text: The pseudo-alignment tool ___ uses k-mer equivalence classes and provides extremely fast transcript-level RNA-seq quantification without producing a BAM file.
explanation: kallisto uses k-mer equivalence classes to rapidly assign reads to transcripts without full alignment, making it much faster than BAM-based counting tools like featureCounts. Salmon is a similar pseudo-alignment tool but uses a different probabilistic model rather than k-mer equivalence classes.
